assign.request: Reviewer minion for /imagine/gallery/: ten-second test, primary interaction, layout at 3440, resolve findings in-realm, land.

log.msg: Ten-second test (before fix), 1280 shot: stranger sentence - a short bare list of three links (Lists, Answers, Cards) whose intro talks about a foreign page being imported by path, never adopted, which means nothing on first read; most of the 3440 canvas is empty gray. Meant sentence (readme.md + description): browsable lists of everything the framework can be made of, every card a page borrowed from somewhere else. Matches paging/critique gallery row exactly: 31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 4, three one-line children in a plain list, alt = tile wall. Alternate was NOT applied before this task.

Fix 1 (highest-value): page.js takeaway sentence rewritten in plain language, defining 'foreign page' inline where it first appears, instead of opening on undefined jargon ('imported by path, never adopted'). Caveat: kept the term itself (load-bearing across Answers/readme/doc), just defined it on first use; undo if the owner would rather drop the term entirely.

Fix 2 (layout, matches paging/critique gallery row exactly - 31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 4, alt Tile wall): page.js now sets width full plus index true plus this.previews(), same pattern already verified on /imagine/design/ same night (31 to 97 pct at 3440). Removed the inert initialize columns call - doc/columns.md's shallowest-ancestor rule names /imagine/gallery/ by name as the example of a columns call that does nothing because /imagine/'s hub already owns the row. Caveat: with only 3 real children (vs design's 11) the wall still leaves whitespace at 3440 - that is core's own auto-fill-not-auto-fit decision (Page.css, measured 2026-08-17: auto-fit blew 2 cards to 1623px each) refusing to stretch 3 cards into giant tiles, not a defect in this fix. Undo if the owner wants the plain link list back for a 3-item page.

Fix 3 (layout invariant 3, hard-coded spacing): gallery.css .gal-pair gap 1.5em changed to var(--gap, var(--gap-default)), matching the clamp already used by every other grid on the site (framework.css .gap utility, core's own .page-previews wall). Caveat: purely visual, verified via re-screenshot (public/imagine/gallery/cards/), no layout break.

Primary interaction verified via ui-test drive.mjs (scratchpad gallery-plan4.json, gallery-ui/steps.json): clicking the first card (Lists) navigates to /imagine/gallery/lists/, crumb updates to Imagine Gallery Lists, a real six-item rail appears with a plain takeaway sentence (Six lists. Each one is an array of paths in lists/page.js - nothing crawls.). Zero step errors, zero console errors on all shots (before, after, cards, lists, answers).

Proposal (not fixed - lives outside my realm's files): core/Page/Page.css's default preview_card() truncates a long description with CSS ellipsis (visible on the Answers/Cards cards here, e.g. Can you import a page from anywhere and preview it Four questions four...). A one-line diff - line-clamp 3 instead of 1, or nowrap to normal on .page-preview-desc - would show full descriptions on every card wall site-wide. Left as a proposal because it is core CSS shared by every realm's card wall, not gallery's own file, and changing it site-wide is outside a single reviewer's fences.

Correction before landing: first pass copied /imagine/design/'s width:full pattern verbatim. Re-read this realm's OWN doc/decisions.md first and found a 2026-08-29 entry that tried width:full for a gallery wall and reverted it, because full collapses every ancestor column - here that means /imagine/'s own hub rail disappears for as long as you stay inside Gallery. Verified live: with width:full the hub rail vanished on the landing page itself (a regression vs the before-shot, which had the rail). Switched to width:'large' (64em, fits all 3 cards in one row) instead of full. Re-verified with ui-test: hub rail + Gallery's own card wall + an opened Lists column all stay on screen together, three columns deep, zero console errors. Documented the correction in doc/decisions.md and readme.md so the next agent does not repeat the same wrong copy from design.

Caveat on the width:large choice: it caps the wall at 64em, so if this realm ever grows past ~4-5 real children (unlikely - it is 3 by design, doc/decisions.md 'Lists are separate pages, and lazy'), full width would need reconsidering together with whether the hub rail still matters at that depth. Easy to change: one word (width: 'large' -> 'full') plus removing the two doc lines that explain why not.

assign.outcome:
**Gallery's landing page went from a bare three-line link list (31% of 3440 used, 2180px dead — matched `paging/critique` exactly) to a labelled card wall, and the missing takeaway sentence is fixed.** Stranger test now passes: `/imagine/gallery/`.

- Fixed `page.js`: plain-language opening sentence, `foreign page` defined inline on first use; `index: true` + `this.previews()` draws Lists/Answers/Cards as cards instead of a plain nav list; removed an inert `initialize(){ this.columns(); } ` call (doc/columns.md's 'shallowest ancestor' rule names this exact page as the example of one that does nothing).
- Chose `width: "large"`, not `"full"` — caught before landing that `full` reproduces a regression this realm's own `doc/decisions.md` already tried and reverted on 2026-08-29 (it collapses `/imagine/`'s hub rail for as long as you're inside Gallery). `large` fits all 3 cards in one row and keeps the rail; verified live with `ui-test` three columns deep (hub rail + Gallery wall + an opened Lists column, all on screen together).
- Fixed `gallery.css`: `.gal-pair`'s hard-coded `gap: 1.5em` now reads `var(--gap, var(--gap-default))`, the same clamp every other grid on the site uses.
- Verified the primary interaction end to end (`ui-test drive.mjs`): clicking the Lists card navigates to `/imagine/gallery/lists/`, crumb updates, a real six-item rail appears with its own plain takeaway sentence. Zero console errors on every shot (landing at 1280/3440, cards/, lists/, answers/).
- Proposed, not fixed (core CSS, outside my fences): `core/Page/Page.css`'s default card description truncates to one line with an ellipsis — a `line-clamp` bump would show full descriptions on every card wall site-wide, not just here.

![Gallery, fixed](/framework/ai/2026-09-04/imagine-review/shots/gallery.jpg)

Documented the width:large-not-full correction in `doc/decisions.md` and `readme.md` so the next agent doesn't copy `/imagine/design/`'s `width: full` here and reintroduce the exact regression this realm already reverted once.
